metadata.title: Yasen
metadata.description: Inventory and sales for a small retail shop.

home.title: Yasen
home.subtitle: Inventory and sales for a small shop.
home.stageNotice: Stage 1 (MVP) is in progress. The owner dashboard isn't built yet.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: The page didn't load. Trying again usually fixes it.

offlineBanner.message: No internet. Changes here won't save — wait for the connection. Sales can be entered offline:

productNotes.triggerLabel: {count, plural, =0 {Add a note for {product}} =1 {1 note for {product}} other {# notes for {product}}}
productNotes.invalidInput: Choose a type and enter the note text.

noteTypes.sectionDescription: Instead of ink colours in the notebooks — type a note, pick a colour.
noteTypes.invalidInput: Enter a name and choose a colour.

login.title: Log in
login.invalidInput: Enter a valid email and password.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: For the whole shop · only the owner sees and changes this · ✓ changes save instantly
settings.shopDescription: How the shop looks in the app and on printed documents.
settings.taglineHint: Under the name in the header
settings.logoHint: PNG or JPG. Also used as the tab icon and on the phone
settings.brandColorsHint: Shades and contrast are picked automatically; warnings are always red
settings.timezoneHint: Days and months are counted in the shop's time zone
settings.supplierTrackingHint: Turning it off hides the field, the list and the filters; nothing entered is lost
settings.monthCloseHint: After this, documents for the month no longer change — only a correction can
settings.paymentMethodsHint: Each one is its own column in the cash box
settings.restockDescription: Values for every product; a single product can override its own in its card.
settings.velocityThresholdHint: A product goes on the list once sales since the start of the month reach this share of what was there plus what arrived
settings.archiveProductsHint: No stock or movement for longer than
settings.sellersHint: Enter sales and see stock, without analytics or profit
settings.logoutDescription: End the session on this device.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Where the stock is: warehouses and shops. Stock is counted separately per location.
locations.cannotDeleteNote: A location with stock can't be deleted — only renamed or retyped; move its stock first.
locations.invalidInput: Enter a name and choose a type.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: {categoryCount} categories, {subcategoryCount} subcategories · order here = order in the sales table
categories.archiveDisabledHint: This category still has products — move them to another category first.
categories.keyboardHint: Focus the handle and use the arrow keys to reorder from the keyboard.
categories.selectPrompt: Select a category to edit it.
categories.moveProductsButtonTop: Move all products to another category…
categories.moveProductsButtonSub: Move all products to another subcategory…

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}} · who you buy what from, and for how much
suppliers.scrollCaption: The list scrolls to the end with no pages.
suppliers.noProductsHint: No products have this supplier as their default yet.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: {productCount, plural, =1 {# product} other {# products}} in {categoryCount, plural, =1 {# category} other {# categories}}
products.invalidInput: Check the required fields and price format.
products.scrollCaption: The list scrolls to the end with no pages — only visible rows are shown.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.listSubtitle: Stock between warehouse and shop · {month}: {count, plural, =1 {# transfer} other {# transfers}}
transfers.directionHint: Only what's currently in stock is listed.
transfers.noAvailableProducts: No products with stock at this location.
transfers.selectedCountFooter: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} selected
transfers.invalidInput: Select at least one product and enter a quantity.
transfers.insufficientStockError: Only {available} of "{product}" available at the source location.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · at purchase cost: {amount} UAH
stock.invalidInput: Enter a quantity and choose a reason.

stocktake.title: Stocktake

stocktake.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No discrepancies} other {# discrepancies}} · shortage {shortage} · surplus {surplus}

cashSummary.title: Cash box
cashSummary.hint: Click a date in the table header to see another day's cash box.
cashSummary.invalidInput: Enter a valid discount amount, e.g. 105.50.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: {location} · {productCount, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} in {categoryCount, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}

sales.showOnlyWithSales: only with sales in the period
sales.moreCategoriesHint: {count, plural, one {# more category} other {# more categories}} below · press “/” and start typing a name…
sales.noPriceError: One of the entered products has no sale price set yet — set a price first.
sales.offlinePill: No internet · {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} on this device

sales.rejectedPill: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} not accepted

receipts.title: Goods receipts

receipts.dayGroupSummary: {count, plural, one {# receipt} other {# receipts}} · {amount} UAH
receipts.newSupplierLabel: Or type a new supplier name
receipts.minStockHint: Defaults to 10% of the quantity. The product appears in the catalogue once posted.
receipts.splitChildHint: prices shared with the row above
receipts.addProductPlaceholder: Add a product — name or SKU; we'll create a new one if there's no match
receipts.invalidInput: Check the supplier, locations and prices, and that every new product has a name and category.

validation.supplierRequired: Select a supplier or type a new one's name
validation.lineQuantityRequired: Line {line}: quantity must be a positive whole number

receipts.correctionNote: A correction keeps both versions and only adjusts stock by the difference. Once the month is closed, “Correct” becomes unavailable.
receipts.notFound: This receipt doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
